name: Volvo Car AB (publ.)
summary: Volvo Car AB (publ.) is an international automotive enterprise responsible for the design, development, manufacturing, marketing, assembly, and sale of passenger vehicles. Its operations span major global regions, including Europe, China, the United States, and various other international markets. The company's product line features a variety of sedans and sport utility vehicles (SUVs) sold under its prominent Volvo brand. Furthermore, it supplies electric vehicles available through both the Volvo and Polestar marques. In addition to complete vehicles, Volvo Car AB (publ.) also provides automotive parts and accessories, and facilitates sales via its digital platforms. Founded in 1927, the company maintains its corporate headquarters in Gothenburg, Sweden. It operates as a subsidiary of Geely Sweden Holdings AB.
